Buddhism is a religion founded by [[The Buddha]]. It has been highly influential on [[Lifeism]]. It is sometimes seen as having branched off from [[Hinduism]]. It is a [[Dharmic religions|Dharmic religion]]

== Influence on Lifeism ==
Buddhism has been most influential on Lifeism for the following reasons

* [[John Vervaeke]]
* [[Alok Kanojia]]
* Use as a model for syncretism with [[Shinto]] in [[Japan]]
* The [[Bardo Thodol]] and various other Vajrayana practices influencing the development and practices of Lifeism
